notes: 어머니 is the standard, polite term for 'mother'. In casual speech within the family, 엄마 ('mom') is much more common.
Use 어머니 when speaking about your mother to others, or 어머님 (honorific) when referring to someone else's mother.

examples.translation: My mother is very good at cooking.
